newsitem.title: USA: Home Products Int'l completes offering.
newsitem.headline: Home Products Int'l completes offering.

text.p: Home Products International Inc, which makes and markets housewares and storage containers, said Wednesday it completed a public offering of 3.5 million shares of its common stock at $9.75 per share.
Net proceeds from the offering to the company were about $18.3 million. Home Products will use the proceeds to pay down the debt used to acquire Tamor Corp in March 1997.
Of the total shares, 2.0 million shares were new shares offered by the company and 1.5 million shares were outstanding shares offered by the selling shareholders.
No shares are being sold by company management.
Underwriters were led by EVEREN Securities Inc and Montgomery Securities.
Shares of Home Products were trading off 7/8 at 9-3/4.
